headline: Barely a foot of short-period S — flat and forgettable.
today: Under 1.5ft at 4.6s means this is basically flat. Offshore N in the morning keeps what little there is clean before the SSW onshore fills in. Skip it unless you just want a paddle.

daysToWatch.note: Head-high on a good SSE angle, but 16-17mph S onshore blows it out through midday. Evening drops to 5mph — cleaner window if the swell holds.
The one to circle — 1.5-2.5ft on a prime ESE angle with N offshore all day. Clean and fun, shortboard or fish.
SSW onshore 11-14mph all day over a small swell. Choppy junk.
S swell to 3.9ft (short-period) with light winds — worth a look for a clean session if it comes together.
